title: Halloween Party Bus vs. Limo in Orange County | Which Is Better?
description: Party bus or limo for Halloween in Orange County? We break down capacity, real costs, and which one wins for Knott's, Disney and HHN. Call (714) 605-4550.
h1: Halloween Party Bus vs. Limo in Orange County: Which Is Better?

blocks.text: Ten people or more, book the party bus. Fewer than ten, book the limo. That's the whole answer, and we're not going to make you read a couple thousand words to get it.

blocks.text: When the Party Bus Wins

Here's the part nobody plans for. When a park empties onto a single road at 1 AM, cell service thins out and surge pricing triples. That's not the moment you want to be arguing with an app. The ride home is the hardest leg of the whole night, and we've picked up enough groups in that hour to know exactly how it goes.

blocks.text: Knott's Scary Farm (Buena Park). This is the one closest to our Anaheim shop, about five miles. Gates at 7 PM, good nights running until 1 or 2 AM, through October 31, 2026. Parking is $25 and up, and getting out takes longer than getting in. We drop at the main entrance, park somewhere sane, and your driver is already staged when the fogs clear. Nobody stands on a sidewalk refreshing Uber at 1:40 in the morning. Our Knott's Scary Farm party bus page has the round-trip details.

blocks.text: How far in advance should I book for Halloween?

Two to three weeks for a normal night, sooner for October 30 or 31. Those are the last weekends of the season, and all three haunts are running at once. Booking a Scary Farm night on October 31? Call this week. Groups coming down from Irvine or Santa Ana are usually the ones who regret waiting.

blocks.text: Do you wait for us at the park?

Yes. We set a fixed return time based on the park's posted close and stage your vehicle so you walk straight out to it. No waiting fee for the hours we sit parked, and nobody gets left on a sidewalk in a costume at 2 AM wondering where the car went.
